purpose: Offer a tentative prediction or seek agreement.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain clause + だろう; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ before it.
It will probably be sunny tomorrow.
formation: Plain clause + だろう; nouns and な-adjectives omit だ before it.
restrictions: Agreement-seeking intonation can sound forceful; use でしょう for polite conversation.
mistake: だろう is an estimate, not evidence that the event is certain.
